$comment: Single source of truth for username validation, consumed by crates/server/src/auth/username.rs (include_str!) and apps/web/src/api/account.ts (JSON import). `pattern` encodes the charset and hyphen rules: lowercase alphanumerics with single interior hyphens. `messages` are the user-facing rejection strings; `{min}`/`{max}` are substituted from the length bounds. Keep `reserved` lowercase and sorted.

messages.charset: Username may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
messages.hyphens: Username cannot start, end, or contain consecutive hyphens
